notes.title: Monthly Update - May
notes.notes:
ACE Strategy: Mecha Nova is a tactical roguelike deck building game. Recruit elite mecha pilots, deploy drones and cast commands. Master your ACE mechas while collecting unique cards and chips in battles, and form your own build for total battlefield dominance.

1. New Additions
● 9 New Enemy Stages: Face more complex tactical challenges.
● 25 New Cards: Double the card pool for expanded deck-building strategies!

2. Balance Adjustments
● Card tuning: Smoother power curve, reduced extreme high/low-roll scenarios.
● Stage difficulty refined: More forgiving early-game, fiercer late-game threats.

3. Visual Enhancements
● UI Overhaul: Streamlined layout for clearer combat feedback.
● Mech-Specific Effects: Added unique animations for enhanced card impact.

● Pilot the ACE-001 "WhiteDwarf" prototype in Sector S6-007 (Centaurus Dust Belt of the Southern Gate Binary Star) for field testing and exploration.

● This mission is off the official record. If successful, all rewards are yours to keep. If you fail, we’ll reclaim the prototype wreckage and all your exploration/combat data to integrate into the sector’s spatial database.

Longquan Space Station in Sector S6 — ACE Test Pilot Recruitment
 | Discord: https://discord.gg/Hvn8PVG3Wx  | 

"May the vast cosmos sparkle alongside you!"

————————————————————————————————————————


[b]Playtest Update Notes[/b]

[Game Rules]
● Play as a mech pilot, choosing from different mech factions to start your roguelike campaign. Progress through randomized stages, collect mechs and gear, build unique strategies, and defeat epic bosses.
● Deploy three types of units: ACE Mechas, ACE Allies, and Drones. Both sides occupy a 3x3 battlefield, with up to 9 units per side.
● Destroy the enemy’s Mecha to win the match.

[Key Features]
● ACE Allies: ACE Allies are as powerful as your ACE Mechas, with diverse skills. Deploying an ACE Ally can turn the tide of battle.
● Drone Stacking: Stack identical drones in the same grid to save space and boost firepower. Some stacks unlock special abilities!
● Direction Abilities: Certain drones boost adjacent allies. Smart positioning creates 1+1>2 combos.
● Items and Chips: Earn powerful Items and Chips during your campaign. Make your choice carefully and boost your build!

[Additional Notes]
● This version is still in active development. Content volume, balance, and visuals are not final—we welcome your feedback!
● Many players asked about PVP—hang tight! We’ll launch PVP testing soon, built on the roguelike foundation.
"Keep an eye out for more stellar updates!"

notes.title: ACE Strategy：The Evolution of the Mecha Card Game - Take 1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I’m Z.Y., one of the developers of ACE Strategy. As the Year of the Loong fades and the Year of the Snake approaches, we’ve decided to start updating developer logs to keep you more informed of our development progress!

ACE Strategy underwent several iterations throughout 2024, and since October, we’ve made significant adjustments to the gameplay. We plan to release a more complete demo in Q1 2025. In the meantime, we aim to conduct small-scale online playtests in the next 2weeks to help us refine the gameplay further.

This version will focus on PVE deck-building gameplay, simplifying card battles. By emphasizing the synergy of mechas and drones on the battlefield, we aim to deliver a strategic and immersive experience of mecha space battles in future roguelike PVE campaigns.

The current development progress is at around 35% and does not represent the final quality. Due to time constraints, this version is only available in Simplified Chinese, but English and Japanese versions will follow as soon as possible.  

If you are interested, please reach out to us for a Steam Key, and those who already have a key can directly update their Steam to play.

Thank you for your support, and Happy Chinese New Year!

[Version Update Notes]
【Gameplay Modes】
[list]
[*]  Roguelike campaign mode will be introduced in the coming build, featuring multiple levels in each campaign.
[*]  Choose a mecha, enter campaign challenges, earn rewards, and build your deck to ultimately face powerful enemies and complete campaign objectives.
[*] The battle field has been adjusted from 1v1 to a grid-based  3x3 +3x3 map, where players can deploy drones and ACE Mechas in combat.
[/list]

【UX  & Visual Changes】
[list]
[*]  Adjusted camera distance to focus on a comprehensive view of the battlefield.
[/list]

【Card Design】
[list]
[*] We have simplified text description of tactical cards with complex effects.
[*] Introduced drone cards, various tactical strategies can be built around your ACE Mecha.
[*] Design ACE wingman cards, featuring tactics for more intuitive offensive and defensive effects.
[/list]

【Mecha Design】
[list]
[*] Moduelize ACE mechas, modules can be collected and assembled during battles to enhance stats, upgrade appearances, and unlock unique skills.
[*] In this test, the player-controlled ACE mecha is Orion, which can acquire exclusive modules during campaigns:
[/list]
[list]
[*] Unlock special skills, deploying two floating cannons .
[*] Enhance the two floating cannons to unleash more powerful finishing moves.
[*] More wingman mechas will be introduced in the future, including Battle-Core, White Dwarf, and Crux, creating diverse strategies,
[*] The current version’s mechas are not in their final form and will temporarily appear in the game as special wingmen or enemies.
[/list]

notes.title: ACE Strategy playtest ending announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Pilots,

Thank you to everyone who participated in the first playtest of ACE Strategy. Your enthusiasm and feedback have been invaluable, helping us continuously refine and improve the game!

As we dive deeper into development, we will be temporarily closing the playtest servers for this phase. Once the new version is ready, we will announce and launch a fresh round of playtest!

[b]Server Down Time[/b]: November 14, 2024.
[b]Next Launch Time[/b]: Estimated in 1-2 months, a brand new game experience will be introduced.

During the downtime, our team will be fully committed to extensive game optimization and content updates, ensuring an even more exciting experience for everyone when we meet again.

We greatly value every piece of feedback from our pilot community. If you have any suggestions or questions, please communicate with us via Discord or other platforms.

Thank you again for your support and understanding. The universe of ACE Strategy is brighter because of you. Let's look forward to regrouping on a brand-new battlefield soon!

Sincerely,
ACE Strategy Development Team

notes.title: ACE Strategy closed beta announcement
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141303/80019951ebfa53445fb9adff07a37768583cc5ba.jpg[/img]

Dear mecha enthusiasts and card game players, we are thrilled to announce that after one year of relentless development, the mecha TCG ACE Strategy is finally ready to make its debut!

ACE Strategy is a mecha TCG where you can pilot various mechas, build your strategies and decks, and engage in battles with pilots across the universe.

In the coming test, you'll experience:
● [b]9 uniquely designed mechas[/b] with distinct styles, ready to dominate the interstellar battlefield!
● [b]Over 200 cards to collect[/b], allowing for diverse playstyles—build your battle system with endless strategies!
● [b]Over 10 stunning ultras[/b] to showcase your ultimate techniques to your opponents! Unleash your power! 
● [b]Dozens of PVE stages and powerful bosses await[/b], offering rare cards and upgrades to enhance your strength!
● [b]Choose between ranked and normal matches[/b] to compete with pilots from across the stars and claim your place as the GRAND ACE!

The test server will open on [b]24 Oct 2024 (EST)[/b], and the test is expected to last for [b]3 weeks[/b].

We invite players who wish to participate in our beta test to complete a survey. We will grant test access to players who meet our expectations. For more information, please visit: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3127770/view/4513261623761498042?l=english

Your feedback is crucial to us! If you encounter any issues during the test, feel free to join our official Discord channel or any other way you can reach us to report them. 

Lastly, if you'd like to learn more about ACE Strategy or connect with other fellow players, do visit our social media. We will also distribute test access via social media during the test period!

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141303/ae2ac5cd46b5bc8eab697822c233410e14c8be84.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Details[/b][/h2]
We now invite fellow pilots to our first closed beta of ACE Strategy! This will be a small-scale closed test. Pilots can click the link below to fill out the survey, and by completing the survey, you'll have a chance to earn a spot in the test.

Survey URL: [url=https://forms.gle/WKfmTbrtfYVUDwXw9]Welcome to our Playtest[/url]
Recruiting From: Oct/17/2024

[h2][b]Q&A[/b][/h2]
Q: [b]How will test access be distributed?[/b]
A: Test access will be distributed via the email address provided by each pilot in the survey, so please ensure that you fill it out correctly.

Q: [b]What type of test is this?[/b]
A: This is a small-scale, closed beta test with progress being wiped afterward.

Q: [b]When is the recruitment deadline for this test?[/b]
A: Recruitment will remain open throughout the testing period, and pilots will have a chance to gain test access until the end of the test.

Q: [b]When will test access be distributed?[/b]
A: We will begin selecting participants after receiving their surveys. Due to server capacity and other factors, test access will be distributed in batches based on the order in which surveys are received.

Q: [b]What languages will be supported in this test?[/b]
A: Simplified Chinese and English clients will be tested in this beta. More languages will be supported in our coming releases.

Q: [b]What platform is this test on?[/b]
A: The test will be available on PC and distributed by Steam. For more information about the mobile version, please follow the ACE Strategy social media down below.
